name: Keihan Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Keihan Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the transportation and various other businesses in Japan. It operates through Transportation, Real Estate Business, Distribution Industry, Leisure Service Industry, and Other Business segments. The Transportation segment is involved in railroad and bus operations. The Real Estate Business segment engages in real estate sales and rentals, and wholesale of building materials, as well as offers surveying and design services. The Distribution Industry segment manages department stores, retail stores, and shopping malls. The Leisure Service Industry segment engages in hotels and sightseeing boats businesses.
